findings.finding: invitations.id, invitations.token and project_roles.id are distinct facts with no typed mapping or FK between invitation, accepted user, member and reservation.
UI DELETE nested /invitations/{invitationId} has no matching route.ts; implemented DELETE reads ?invitation_id= and authenticates cookies only.

Separate pending pre-read, declined update and wallet read/current+1 write; no reserved-seat proof, conditional pending update, lock or release log; wallet write error ignored. Original inviter checked, not current project facilitator.
findings.observed: Static source risk; no concurrency execution in Task 1

findings.finding: Expiry handlers mutate only status, without reservation release; writes lack pending predicate and may overwrite a concurrent acceptance. Some updates are not awaited or errors ignored.

Service cleanup callsites do not change the fixed routine meaning: it targets project_roles.invited_at (missing), not invitations expiry or wallet release; previous PG17 42703. Project-list call and cron GET ignore RPC returned error.

Missing-wallet fallbacks directly write project_vouchers=1, facilitator_seats=2, storyteller_seats=2 then separately insert grant/initial_package log, whose values violate fixed CHECKs. Own-zero condition is not a durable trusted grant identity. Existing-zero RPC branch currently has prior missing-column failure evidence.
findings.observed: Source and schema comparison only; no balance mutation executed

findings.finding: Fixed own-wallet insert/update and own-transaction insert policies plus table ACL permit self-scoped write paths without trusted payment/reservation provenance. Prior purchase routines do not verify trusted payment. This audit does not claim a successful remote exploit or successful purchase.

Token route debug payload includes candidates/db_token; check-pending logs returned invitation objects and acceptance UI logs token/details. Future adapter must not retain raw tokens in logs/debug/telemetry.
EmailService calls auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail and returns false on error; project API ignores boolean and returns 201. No proof of delivery or membership acceptance.

sourceOfTruth.memberAccess: public.project_roles plus projects.facilitator_id/current active project checks
sourceOfTruth.reservation: future persistent typed invitation/reservation/accepted-user mapping and constraints required; not present in current snapshot

atomicBoundary: Verified non-null user identity and provider-confirmed matching email, not request metadata or mere link possession.
Parse defined token protocol and locate exactly one invitation; reject ambiguous historical variants; no raw token logging.

Locate project, lock and revalidate active project and current facilitator inviter, pending status, allowed role and expiry. Maintain project-before-role order and define one compatible invitation/wallet/reservation lock order for accept/cancel/expire/transfer.
Require durable unconsumed reservation with correct invitation/project/role/payer/amount and trusted entitlement provenance. No implicit grant or inferred reservation from wallet balance.

In same transaction bind authenticated user to unique project membership and persist mapping, activate member/joined_at, accept invitation/accepted_at, consume reservation and ledger changes. Any failure rolls all affected facts back.

caseRules.unregisteredEmail: Keep email invitation and reservation, no synthetic user/member. Register and verify email, reauthenticate then atomically accept.
caseRules.duplicateSend: Future durable idempotency/uniqueness reuses one valid pending invitation and reservation; current pre-read plus token uniqueness is insufficient.
caseRules.duplicateAccept: No new member, debit or joined_at overwrite. Future adapter may report already-accepted only with durable same-user mapping and still-valid access; legacy Task 2 member-ID RPC explicitly rejects active repeats.
caseRules.existingOrRevokedMember: Reject different-role/inactive/deleted/rebound conflicts; never revive access by blind upsert or token retry.
caseRules.cancelled: Current legal status is declined, not cancelled. Future explicit cancellation meaning, current authority and exactly-once release of verified unconsumed reservation required.
caseRules.expired: Database clock, expires_at<=now rejects. Serialize with accept/cancel; release verified unconsumed reservation once and retain history. Missing historical reservation is not a reason to credit +1.
caseRules.unknownCommit: Timeout/lost response/post-RPC fetch error/bad TABLE shape remains unknown until authenticated lookup of the same mapped invitation/member/reservation proves result; no automatic reinvite, debit, release or new token.
caseRules.fallback: No service fallback, direct-table grant, legacy project_members/project_invitations write or token-variant write retries after auth/contract failure. Preserve committed history; disable new write entry on adapter rollback.

futureAdapter.resultValidation: RPC error first; explicit TABLE unpack; exactly one row and types/user/project/role/status/joined_at verified; old token success field must be true if that interface is intentionally retained. Never use pre-read fallback as write proof.
futureAdapter.emailBoundary: Persistent post-commit delivery identity/outcome; retry same invite without second reserve. Creation, provider acceptance and delivery are separate outcomes.
